# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure_nodes (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure_nodes" "example_zero_trust_cws_tenant_structure_nodes" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  structure_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
  name = "name"
  native_id = "native_id"
  node_kind = "node_kind"
  parent = "parent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `structure_id` (String) ID of the parent tenant structure

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (String) Filter by node name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `native_id` (String) Filter by exact cloud-native identifier
- `node_kind` (String) Filter by exact node kind
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `parent` (String) Filter by exact parent native ID

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `name` (String) Display name (e.g. an OU or account name), mutable. Optional; empty by default.
- `native_id` (String) Cloud-native identifier of this node, unique within the structure; the parent-reference target. Shape depends on the structure's application. Immutable after create.
- `node_kind` (String) Position in the tree. Legal values depend on the structure's application (aws: root/ou/account; cloudflare: org/account/zone). At most one root per structure. Immutable after create.
- `parent` (String) Native ID of this node's parent. Required for non-root nodes and omitted for the root. The parent must be in the same structure and able to contain this node kind.
- `updated_at` (String)
